name: Focus Appearance
explanation: This criterion sets precise, measurable rules for how visible a keyboard focus indicator has to be. It goes beyond SC 2.4.7's requirement that one merely exists. The focus indicator must cover an area at least as large as a 2 CSS pixel thick border traced around the unfocused component. The color used for that indicator must also have a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against the component's unfocused colors. Effects like a soft blur or glow don't count toward meeting this. They don't reliably produce a crisp, measurable boundary the way a solid outline or border does.
whoItAffects: People with low vision need a focus indicator that's not just present, but genuinely prominent and high-contrast enough to actually notice while tabbing through a page. This matters most on complex or visually busy interfaces, where a thin or low-contrast outline can get lost. This criterion builds on SC 2.4.7's baseline requirement that some focus indicator exists at all. It makes sure that indicator actually works well for people who need strong visual cues, not just a technically-present but hard-to-see one.
howToTest: Tab to each interactive element and check its focus indicator with a contrast tool. Measure its thickness against a 2 pixel minimum. Then measure the contrast ratio between the indicator and the unfocused color, and confirm it's at least 3:1. A focus indicator that's only a soft glow or shadow fails this criterion, even if it's visible, since it has no crisp edge.

check.question: A button's focus style is a soft, blurred box-shadow glow with no solid outline, and while it's visible, its measurable edge contrast against the button's unfocused background falls below 3:1. Does this pass SC 2.4.13 Focus Appearance?
choices: Yes, because any visible change on focus satisfies this criterion
No, because a soft glow effect doesn't meet the required contrast ratio and defined perimeter thickness
Yes, because box-shadow is a valid CSS technique for focus styling
It depends only on whether the button also has a visible label
